```artifact
Feature: Account Creation

  Scenario Outline: Create account with unique ID
    Given the system is ready
    When I create an account with ID "<account_id>"
    Then the account should be created with ID "<account_id>"
    And the initial balance should be 0

    Examples:
      | account_id |
      | ACC001     |
      | ACC       |

  Scenario: Reject duplicate account creation
    Given an account with ID "ACC001" already exists
    When I create an account with ID "ACC001"
    Then the system should raise a DuplicateAccount error
```

```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Create account with unique ID - normal",
    "req_ids": ["FR-1"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["system ready"],
    "inputs": {"account_id": "ACC001"},
    "steps": ["create account with ID ACC001"],
    "expected": ["account created with ID ACC001", "initial balance 0"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Create account with unique ID - edge",
    "req_ids": ["FR-1"],
    "kind": "boundary",
    "preconditions": ["system ready"],
    "inputs": {"account_id": "ACC"},
    "steps": ["create account with ID ACC"],
    "expected": ["account created with ID ACC", "initial balance 0"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Reject duplicate account creation",
    "req_ids": ["FR-2"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["account with ID ACC001 exists"],
    "inputs": {"account_id": "ACC001"},
    "steps": ["create account with ID ACC001"],
    "expected": ["DuplicateAccount error"]
  }
]
```
